initial_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. I prefer properties near public transport.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. I prefer properties near public transport.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Schools and educational activities' AND mobility >= 88 ORDER BY id ASC

scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near public transport.

requirements.description: Prefers proximity to public transport; threshold rounded from the 75th percentile of 87.77.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Schools and educational activities' AND mobility >= 88 ORDER BY id ASC
